count_set_bits: count the number of set bits in an integer using Brian Kernighan algorithm
run_f_gold: run f_gold to count set bits in a given integer recursively
test_f_filled: test the f_filled implementation against f_gold using the provided test parameters
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use an iterative approach instead of recursion
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that counts set bits using bitwise operations
